# Restricted API keys

---

Use Restricted API keys for fine-grained control over access to Twilio API resources. You can create and manage Restricted API keys using the REST API [Key resource v1](https://twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v1) or the [Twilio Console](https://console.twilio.com).

Restricted API keys allow you to grant API access to many Twilio API endpoints, including:

- [Studio](https://twilio.com/docs/studio)
- [Voice](https://twilio.com/docs/voice), [Conversation Intelligence (classic)](https://twilio.com/docs/conversation-intelligence-classic), [Voice Insights](https://twilio.com/docs/voice/voice-insights), and [SIP](https://twilio.com/docs/voice/sip)
- [Messaging](https://twilio.com/docs/messaging)
- [Long Codes](https://twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers), [Regulatory Compliance](https://twilio.com/docs/phone-numbers/regulatory/api)
- [TaskRouter](https://twilio.com/docs/taskrouter)
- [Monitor Events](https://twilio.com/docs/usage/monitor-events) and [Monitor Alerts](https://twilio.com/docs/usage/monitor-alert)
- [Lookup](https://twilio.com/docs/lookup)
- [Verify](https://twilio.com/docs/verify)
- [Video](https://twilio.com/docs/video)
- [Event Streams](https://twilio.com/docs/events)
- [Usage Records](https://twilio.com/docs/usage/api/usage-record)
- [Serverless](https://twilio.com/docs/serverless)
- [Identity and Access Management (IAM)](https://twilio.com/docs/iam)
- Flex: The Flex Insights Historical Reporting and Self-Signed Certificate API keys permissions are currently in private beta and not available for general use. For more information, contact your Twilio account executive.

For example, if your Programmable Voice application's testing suite makes test Voice calls, you can create a Restricted API key that permits only sending `POST` requests to [create Call Resources](https://twilio.com/docs/voice/api/call-resource).

Or you can create Restricted API keys that provide your engineering team with access to every Voice endpoint except the Call Recording Resource endpoints.

(warning)

## Warning

You can't create [Access Tokens](https://twilio.com/docs/iam/access-tokens) for Twilio's client-side SDKs with Restricted API keys.

---

## Working with Restricted API keys

### Create and manage Restricted API keys

- Learn how to use the [Twilio Console to create and manage API keys](https://twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/keys-in-console).
- Learn how to use the [REST API to create and manage API keys](https://twilio.com/docs/iam/api-keys/key-resource-v1).

### Authenticate with a Restricted API key

Twilio uses the Restricted key's SID and secret as your credentials when sending API requests.

Read the [Requests to Twilio](https://twilio.com/docs/usage/requests-to-twilio) page to learn more.
